The '''Imperial Science Bureau Cybernetic Research Center''' was a research facility focusing on [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] that was run by the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]]. However, it was lost during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], with the facility being severely damaged and costing the Bureau an immense amount of research data and materials.<ref name="Mission" />
